title: feat(engine): vault profiler as graph node + multi-provider LLM factory
body: Promote vault profiling from an opaque executor pre-pass into a real LangGraph node with first-class observability, and generalize the chat-model construction path so per-agent LLM choice (including a non-OpenAI provider) is YAML-driven. Architecture (Path B): - Add NodeName.VAULT_PROFILER and ResearchState.vault_profile (string). - Move profile machinery from app/engine/executor.py into a dedicated app/engine/nodes/vault_profiler.py: vault_stats, profile cache, rendering, profiler-user-message builder, and the vault_profiler_node itself. Executor no longer carries profile-specific code. - Wire the workflow as: START -> vault_profiler -> researcher -> summarizer -> zettelkasten -> persist -> END. - Drop $vault_profile from the researcher and summarizer prompts. Zettelkasten gets the rendered block at runtime as a prepended SystemMessage via a small custom node wrapper, so researcher/summarizer never see it but zettelkasten can honor vault conventions verbatim (kebab-case slugs, frontmatter shape, etc.). - Executor now seeds state.vault_profile="" and stops baking vault_profile into prompt_context. Per-agent LLM overrides in YAML: - AgentPromptConfig.llm: dict[str, JsonValue] layers on top of the global llm: block and below spec.llm_overrides (spec wins for invariants). - spec.llm_kwargs() does the global -> YAML per-agent -> spec merge. - vault_profiler config moves from hardcoded llm_overrides into agent_config.yaml for parity with researcher. Multi-provider chat-model factory: - _build_chat_model(kwargs) dispatches on provider (default openai). For groq: translate model -> model_name, timeout -> request_timeout; drop OpenAI-only knobs (use_responses_api, reasoning, verbosity, stream_usage, context_management) and the OpenAI-namespaced api_key / base_url (they would otherwise leak the OpenAI key to ChatGroq and produce a 401). - Auth: settings.GROQ_API_KEY is declared on Settings so pydantic reads it from .env; the factory injects it explicitly because pydantic-settings does not propagate values to os.environ. - Route vault_profiler to provider: groq, model: openai/gpt-oss-20b (temperature 0.2, no streaming). Validated end-to-end against the live API; profiler node now runs ~1.5s on Groq vs ~5-6s on nano. Researcher tuning: - temperature: 0.3 (down from global 0.8) to reduce run-to-run variance and curb over-exploration seen in Phoenix traces. - Replace the loose blurb with an explicit rubric naming every tool and forbidding shell/curl for URL fetching (exa.crawling_exa for known URLs; web_search / exa / deepwiki for discovery; code_interpreter for math; shell strictly for cat /memory/). Logging QoL: - vault_profiler logs now use the same [NODE_NAME] bracket prefix as the other agent nodes ([VAULT_PROFILER] provider=... model=..., cache hit, computing for N notes, etc.). Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e5622-ea6e-7341-ae3d-aa33acfc08c8 --- ## Summary by cubic Promotes vault profiling into the research graph and adds a provider-agnostic chat-model factory with YAML per‑agent LLM overrides (incl. `groq`). Also switches the workflow API to return a typed response with artifact refs; profiler latency drops to ~1.5s and observability improves. - New Features - Research graph: added `vault_profiler` node and `ResearchState.vault_profile`; flow is START → vault_profiler → researcher → summarizer → zettelkasten → persist → END. Zettelkasten prepends the rendered `` as a `SystemMessage` at runtime. - LLMs: per-agent overrides via `agents..llm` in `agent_config.yaml`; spec merges global → YAML per-agent → spec (spec wins). Provider-agnostic factory supports `groq` and translates keys (e.g. `model`→`model_name`), dropping OpenAI-only knobs. `vault_profiler` defaults to `provider: groq`, model `openai/gpt-oss-20b`. - Researcher: temperature 0.3 and an explicit tool-routing rubric; `summarizer` and `zettelkasten` drop `shell`. Stream logs buffer reasoning per turn; context editing compacts older tool outputs. - API: `POST /api/v1/workflows/run/{workflow_name}` now returns `WorkflowRunResponse` with `run_id` and artifact refs (`report.md`, `sources.csv`, zettels, new memory files). Only existing files are emitted. Executor mirrors persist’s slugging for zettel paths and diffs `.memories/` to find new files. - Migration - Add `GROQ_API_KEY` to `.env` and reinstall deps to pick up `langchain-groq` and the updated `openai`. - Update clients to consume `WorkflowRunResponse` instead of the raw state. - No prompt changes required; only `$prior_memories` is injected via `prompt_context`. Written for commit 460b106634f35ecc6479adff98e51ab9a894f3dc. Summary will update on new commits. Review in cubic
